integration.scope: All collected cases covered across isolated sessions and targeted reruns.

normalization_plan.note: Diagnostic compiled SELECT; excludes timings from runs concurrent with correctness tests.

metric_definitions.edge_recall: Recall among true pairs that survived blocking.
metric_definitions.blocking_recall: Recall of blocking against all true pairs.
metric_definitions.cluster_recall: Recall of co-clustered pairs against all true pairs.

training_cap.note: quality-only trial; ran alongside integration tests and supplies no timing result

bounded_incremental_baseline.scope: run-all incremental only; no incomplete duration is treated as a successful measurement

incremental_quality_reference.golden_count_difference_explanation: The baseline full assembly retains 216 merge losers; optimized incremental assembly removes them. A subsequent full-assembly repair is validated separately.

full_assembly_repair.note: Correctness fix after the timed image; tested with a fresh million-record load and full rescore after delivery. Matching, training and standardization code are unchanged.
